findings: The run is a genuine TRAIN-fitted LightGBM challenger with nonconstant validation forecasts, not an unexecuted model or a constant placeholder.

Its primary validation pinball value is about 0.000602 dB lower than the separately reviewed direct-neural three-seed ensemble value of about 0.639062 dB. This tiny post-hoc development difference has not been assigned inferential significance and is not a state-of-the-art result.
The report truthfully preserves POST_HOC_DEVELOPMENT_NOT_FINAL_EVALUATION, SOTA claim NOT_ESTABLISHED, no selection, no mid-head resume and peak RSS NOT_MEASURED.
The model differs from B3 in both input features and estimator family/capacity, so the result cannot isolate a causal source of any validation difference.
conditions: Keep this artifact as post-hoc validation evidence only until an independently frozen selection rule is applied.
Do not use this review to authorize calibration access, test access, final evaluation, a SOTA claim or a production claim.
Any model, prediction, cohort, scorer, recipe or runner hash change invalidates this outcome review.
